data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin for AppMetrica to collect usage statistics, analytics, and crash reports.
data.what_it_does: It provides a bridge to the native AppMetrica SDK for Android and iOS. It allows you to collect app usage statistics, custom events, device information, user profiles, revenue metrics, and crash reports.
use_when: You want to integrate Yandex AppMetrica analytics into your Flutter application.
You need to track custom events, user profiles, and in-app sales revenue.
You need automatic crash and error reporting for Android and iOS.
avoid_when: You are using alternative analytics and crash reporting suites like Firebase or Sentry and do not need AppMetrica.
Your target platforms are outside of Android and iOS.
strengths: Supports rich technology reports, user profiles, and revenue metrics out of the box.
Provides automatic crash and error reporting grouped with OS/app version details.
Includes deeplink tracking and advertising identifiers support.
weaknesses: Platform support is limited to Android and iOS.
Requires platform-specific API keys and configuration.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and activate the library using AppMetrica.activate with your API Key.

alternatives.name: sentry_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick Sentry if you prefer centralized error tracking, performance monitoring, and debugging tools over AppMetrica.

alternatives.name: mixpanel_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick Mixpanel if you want a dedicated product analytics platform alternative for tracking user behavior.
